Your information

Privacy policy

How Ranisa Boutique handles information you share when browsing or asking about a customised order.

Effective 27 September 2026

Who we are

Ranisa Boutique is located at 215 Engineers Road, Kanwali, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001. For privacy questions, contact us on WhatsApp or call +91 90045 17938.

Information you choose to share

Our custom-order form asks for your name, the style you want and your description. You may select reference images. The form prepares a WhatsApp message for you to review and send. Selecting images creates a preview in your browser. When you submit, your name, style, description and selected images are saved in Ranisa Boutique’s private Supabase database and storage for responding to your enquiry. Your WhatsApp message includes an enquiry reference so we can match it to your submission. WhatsApp links cannot attach images automatically; you may also attach them in WhatsApp or use your device’s share menu where available. Only share photos you have permission to share.

Google sign-in and your cart

Customer sign-in uses Google through OTPLESS. OTPLESS provides a verified email address and account identifier; the site checks its signed login token before showing your account or cart. Your login token stays in this browser tab until it expires, you sign out or you close the tab. Ranisa Boutique stores the products and quantities in your cart in its private Supabase database under your account identifier so your cart is available when you sign in again. A cart is an enquiry list, not a placed or paid order. Contact the boutique to ask about or request deletion of account and cart information. You can browse styles and enquire without signing in.

How we use it

We use the enquiry details and images you submit, and any WhatsApp messages you send, to respond to your enquiry, discuss measurements, pricing and availability, and fulfil an order you place. WhatsApp handles messages and attachments according to its own privacy terms. We do not sell your enquiry details.

Browsing and other services

The site saves your chosen styles in your browser’s local storage so they remain on the same device. You can remove saved styles on the site or clear your browser’s site data. The contact page embeds Google Maps, and the site loads fonts from Google; these services may receive technical information such as your IP address under their own privacy terms. Hosting services may process routine technical data needed to serve and secure the site. We store a hash of a network identifier to limit repeat form submissions.

Retention and your choices

Browser previews disappear when you leave or reload the page, but submitted images remain in private storage until no longer needed for the purposes described above. To ask about a saved enquiry or request deletion, contact us at +91 90045 17938 on WhatsApp to ask about, correct, or request deletion of information held by the boutique. We keep enquiry images, customer conversations and order information only as needed for enquiries, orders, records and applicable legal obligations. Deleting a boutique copy does not delete copies held in WhatsApp or on your device.

Changes

We may update this notice as our practices change. The date at the top shows when this version took effect.
